creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Every failure this arc turned up ended the same way: a pane renders, paints, and swallows every keystroke. The bridge fails to dial, the socket path moved, the channel could not be opened - three different causes, one symptom, and the symptom is invisible until somebody types.

The core knows: it binds the socket and is told when a bridge connects. So a pane whose channel has been open for some seconds with nothing on the other end is a state Muster can report rather than one a user discovers. Wants a per-pane deadline after the surface is created, an error record naming the pane and what to check, and something on screen - the chrome already has an edge to spend.

Would have caught all three of this arc's bugs without a contract run.
title: 🧪 A pane that never becomes typeable should say so
